coaching_implication: Coach Brandon to state the full company name and reference the specific prior appointment context proactively, rather than relying on the customer to fill in the gap — this won't always happen on recontact calls.

quote: Yeah. Yeah. I'll I'll have that information Monday if that's okay.
stewart_read: The bill is deferred to the appointment day itself rather than captured or texted in during this call. Whether this is a gap depends on lead type: if this is an organic or recycled lead, deferring the bill is schema-permitted; if it's a paid lead, the bill is required before the appointment can be considered fully qualified.
alternative_hypothesis: Given the rep already references 'we have an evaluation for your home' as an existing record, this may be a recycled lead where some qualification data is already on file, making the light-touch bill deferral appropriate rather than a procedural miss.
coaching_implication: Flag as an open question rather than a directive — confirm this customer's lead type with Brandon; if paid, he needs a firmer bill-collection mechanism (text/email now) before Monday; if organic/recycled, the current handling is acceptable.

coaching_implication: For recontact calls, a quick confirmation of what was previously covered ('just to confirm, last time we talked about X, is that still accurate?') gives the closer better continuity context without adding real time to the call.
